title: Bend 2 and the Vibe-Coding Trap
summary: A critical analysis of Bend 2, a high-performance programming language, and the emerging trend of 'vibe-coding' - using AI assistants to write code through conversational prompts rather than explicit implementation details. The article explores the potential pitfalls and limitations of this AI-assisted coding approach.
problem_solved: Examines whether vibe-coding can effectively handle sophisticated programming languages like Bend 2 that require precise control flow and performance optimization.
why_valuable: Provides a balanced, critical perspective on the growing reliance on AI for coding tasks, highlighting where AI assistance falls short for complex software development.
